text: Binary per-row flag from the OP's own title and argument (current supplied text, including marked edits): 1 if, in the OP's own voice, they explicitly invite critique, counter-arguments or challenge to their view (e.g. asking to be convinced or shown wrong) OR state their view with tentative/hedged language (e.g. "I think", "maybe", "I might be wrong", "not sure", "it seems"); 0 if neither is present. Excludes quotations of others or reported opponents' positions unless the OP adopts them as their own. Ignores view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules may still count if relevant. Generic subreddit framing alone is not an explicit invitation unless the OP's text says so. No reconstruction of an initial snapshot. Returns null if both title and argument are missing or malformed.
